change.observedProblem: A fresh 73-source catalog previously set every nextMonitorAt to the import time, so the first organization sweep could dispatch all sources and turn a shared upstream outage into a same-day task and notification surge.
implementedBehavior: Fresh catalog records are distributed by stable JSON index over seven daily buckets, capped by any shorter monitoring cadence.
Existing records preserve nextMonitorAt during metadata-only reconciliation.
Each scheduled organization sweep selects the oldest due records by nextMonitorAt then id and defaults to 12 dispatches.
The sweep reads one extra candidate only to audit hasMoreDue; it does not claim that record.
Manual per-source monitoring, pg-boss retry behavior and the exact third consecutive failure escalation remain unchanged.

backlogFixture.execution: The candidate worker image ran handleComplianceSourceMonitor once for the QA organization with the production database config and a real pg-boss JobQueue.
